summary.en: Recent drone strikes on Colombian military bases in the north have killed three to five soldiers and wounded dozens, showing intensified attacks by armed groups against the army. Armed men entered a house in Toro and murdered three women, adding to civilian casualties. The ELN and FARC dissident factions are fighting over power, leaving civilians under siege. The conflict remains a low-intensity asymmetric war involving the government, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates and far-left guerrillas. The UCDP recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Nylige droneangrep på colombianske militærbaser i nord har drept tre til fem soldater og såret dusinvis, og viser intensiverte angrep fra væpnede grupper mot hæren. Væpnede menn gikk inn i et hus i Toro og drepte tre kvinner, noe som øker antallet sivile ofre. ELN og dissidentfraksjoner av FARC kjemper om makten, og etterlater sivile under beleiring. Konflikten er fortsatt en lavintensiv asymmetrisk krig som involverer regjeringen, paramilitære grupper, kriminelle syndikater og venstreorienterte geriljer. UCDP registrerte 225 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
